PX25-03.effect:
This card is also treated as a Magic card, and is unaffected by opposing effects in Hand.

[Flash] (You can't use this effect while it's on the Field)
During this turn, the symbol of an opposing Spirit/Ultimate is fixed as zero. If you control any Rebirth Spirit/Rebirth Nexus, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. After this effect resolves, you can summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, destroy an opposing Nexus, and draw a card from the deckbottom.
